subject.title: fix(env): propagate service-managed GH_TOKEN to trusted exec

question: Should service-managed GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN be inherited by gateway exec only when host=gateway, security=full, and ask=off, and is the macOS live proof plus cross-platform tests sufficient for that boundary?
rationale: This intentionally makes operator secrets available to model-triggered host commands after reinstall; tests can prove enforcement, but only maintainers can approve the permanent trust and upgrade policy.

options.title: Accept the narrow boundary
options.body: Approve the GitHub-only service-provenance design, require a current-main refresh with green focused checks, and accept the existing macOS proof plus shared systemd coverage.

options.title: Require Linux live proof
options.body: Keep the design but require a redacted real systemd install, restart, and trusted-exec authentication transcript before approval.

options.title: Keep tokens blocked
options.body: Reject environment inheritance and direct operators to GitHub CLI native credential storage or another explicitly approved credential-broker design.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the GitHub-only service-provenance design, require a current-main refresh with green focused checks, and accept the existing macOS proof plus shared systemd coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work on host-environment denylisting and exec security makes this the best available owner for the boundary decision.
